sections.skills: Expertise in sustainable, plant-based culinary arts, recipe development, and food systems. Deep knowledge of regenerative agriculture, fermentation, and traditional cooking techniques. Proven ability in community building, event management, and hosting, effectively translating complex cultural stories into tangible, sensory experiences. Skilled in project management, mentorship, fundraising for community initiatives, and operations for food startups.
sections.vision: Driven by a commitment to food justice, cultural preservation, and the intersection of traditional wisdom with modern innovation. Seeks to build systems that decolonize the kitchen, empower food entrepreneurs, and address food deserts through creative, tech-enabled solutions. Values sustainable impact, communal experiences, and authentic storytelling.
sections.project: Current ongoing projects include developing a cookbook on decolonizing the kitchen, operating a restaurant, and organizing pop-up dining experiences. Specifically seeking to launch a web series on indigenous cooking and a community kitchen space for entrepreneurs. Ideally looking to build an AI-enabled tool or platform that connects local food entrepreneurs with resources, creates digital archives for traditional cooking techniques, or optimizes logistics for mobile kitchen initiatives targeting food deserts.
sections.needs: Seeking a technical partner for software development, specifically someone who can help build and launch a digital platform or web series infrastructure. Needs expertise in AI-driven content platforms, mobile app architecture for logistics, or community-management tools. Looking for teammates with UX/UI design skills who can translate complex cultural visual identity into accessible digital products.
